content: ApplicationDataType defines a subset of the values used in the ModeDeclarationGroup Please note that the corresponding Appli- cationDataType is defining a subset of the values used in the ModeDeclara- tionGroup and the used labels may differ from the names used for the ModeDec- laration s. It is in the responsibility of a system designer to maintain the data types and ModeDec- larationGroup s according to the functional needs. For example, a ModeRequester may only request a subset of the available Modes (via SenderReceiverInterface or ClientServerInterface ). The ModeManager may additionally decide to indicate failure.
